Hawaii

December 21–27, 2019

Overview — Daily Itinerary — Places to Stay

Overview

A Christmas holiday trip to Hawaii. We spent 4 days at Maui and 4 days at Big Island.

I spent time searching for the Hawaii endemic birds, and saw 6 of them:

  • Hawaiian Goose
  • Hawaiian Coot
  • Maui Alauahio
  • Apapane
  • Iiwi
  • Hawaii Amakihi

eBird trip report.
